Meanwhile, Somali piracy has resurged in the Red Sea as the war strains regional enforcement resources. He says no talks with Iran are currently planned. This follows his earlier map claiming the Strait as US territory, a touted naval blockade, and cut-off talks with Iran. Meanwhile, Somali piracy has resurged in the Red Sea as the war strains regional enforcement resources. The UAE has imposed an indefinite trade and financial embargo on Iran over alleged ballistic missile attacks, which Iran denies as a false flag; Iran has reportedly received military materiel from Russia and is threatening Trump's allies and US targets in Europe if the war escalates. The conflict nears its six-month mark with both Washington and Tehran betting they can outlast each other, and reports suggest a possible drawdown of the roughly 50,000 US troops and 20 bases in the region once the war ends. Analysts continue to argue Trump's economic pressure campaign has no clear breaking point for Iran to capitulate, while Trump's approval rating remains at a new low partly due to the war.
